bugs.text: Syntax error: the e.dive object literal contains a stray ',[ ]' after p1, so the entire script fails to parse ('Unexpected token ]'). Nothing runs: no title, no starfield, no input. Confirmed by node --check and by the play-test (all screenshots black, loads_clean=false).

Even with the syntax error fixed, BOSS_HIT is built with makeSprite(BOSS[0].__rows||[]) ; BOSS[0] is a canvas with no __rows, so makeSprite([]) reads rows[0].length on undefined and throws a TypeError at load, again stopping the whole script.
'STAGE N' is never displayed: msgTimer is set but G.msg is never set to a stage string.

Challenging stage scoring is not implemented: G.chHits and G.chWaveHit are never incremented, hits score 100/160 via the normal path, the 1,000 wave bonus does not exist, and PERFECT can never trigger (always shows 0 hits).
Boss escort bonus never applies: escorts are never pushed to b.escorts, so a diving Boss always scores 400 regardless of escorts.
Rescue only happens if the diving Boss is at full health; a Boss already at hp 1 that is carrying the captive is killed by the next hit and the captive is destroyed instead of freed.

Once the beam Boss returns to formation the captive is set to 'held' but its x/y are never updated again, so it would be drawn at a stale position instead of above the Boss; a captive carried by a Boss on a normal dive is never moved and never fires.
drawEnemies references a non-existent e.typeW(e); it is dead code (render draws enemies inline at 981-985) but would throw if ever called.
G.attractDemo is never initialised, so it becomes NaN; harmless since it is unused.

summary: As delivered the file does not run at all: a half-edited object literal at lines 475-477 is a syntax error that stops the browser from parsing the script, and a leftover placeholder at 176-177 would throw a second load-time TypeError even after that fix. The play-test shows a black page at every stage. Read as a draft, the design is fairly complete and reasonably organised (pixel-art sprite factory, seven synthesized Web Audio sounds including a looping tractor-beam oscillator, cubic entry and dive paths, sway/breathe formation, beam capture with pull-up and docking dual fighter, challenge-stage waves, badge denominations, fixed-step loop) and would likely have scored in the upper-middle range once it parsed, though it still carries real rule bugs: no STAGE N text, challenge hits never counted, escort bonus never applied, and rescue only on a full-health Boss. It also shows signs of inattentive assembly: duplicated boss sprite tables, uncalled helpers (canDive, formationState, drawEnemies with an undefined method), a no-op statement, and the two load-breaking lines. Faithful in intent, but as a deliverable it is a non-starting program.
